description: Render content to a downloadable PDF document. Provide exactly one source: { html } (raw HTML you compose — the recommended path), { markdown } (converted to HTML then rendered), or { template, data } (a {{key}} template filled from a data object, server-owned layout). Control page size, orientation, margins, header/footer, and page numbers via pageOptions. Returns a delivery envelope with a documentId, resource URI, pageCount, byte size, and inline base64 when small enough. The lightweight engine renders structured layout (headings, paragraphs, lists, tables) but not arbitrary CSS — a degraded flag is set when unsupported styling is dropped.

pageOptions.description: Page layout options; sensible defaults apply.

footer.description: Optional footer text. Supports the same {{page}} / {{total}} / {{date}} tokens.

header.description: Optional header text. Supports tokens {{page}}, {{total}}, {{date}}, e.g. "Page {{page}} of {{total}}".

margin.description: Page margins; each side is a CSS length like "10mm", "0.5in", or "72pt".

pageNumbers.description: When true, render a "Page N of M" footer automatically.

source.description: The document source — provide exactly ONE of: { html }, { markdown }, or { template, data }.

data.description: Key/value data interpolated into `template`. Extra keys are ignored.

html.description: Raw HTML string; the full document markup composed by the caller.

markdown.description: Markdown string; converted to HTML then rendered. Sugar over the html source.

template.description: A Handlebars-style template string filled with `data`. Server owns layout.

name: docgen_render_pdf

degraded.description: True when the lightweight engine dropped unsupported styling (CSS, images, scripts).

document.description: Delivery envelope for a rendered document — metadata plus resource/inline byte access.

byteSize.description: Size of the rendered artifact in bytes.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the document was rendered.

documentId.description: Opaque id minted by the render/export/fill tool — the chaining key for docgen_get_document and the docgen://document/{id} resource. Format `doc_` + 24 url-safe chars. Obtainable ONLY from a render/export/fill tool output; not guessable or constructible.

downloadUrl.description: Reserved for a future HTTP download route; not emitted in v1 (the field is always absent). Fetch the bytes via resourceUri or inlineBase64 instead.

inlineBase64.description: The document bytes, base64-encoded. Present when the artifact is at or under the inline threshold; omitted (field absent) when larger — fetch via the resource URI instead.

mimeType.description: Mime type of the rendered artifact — PDF or xlsx.

pageCount.description: Number of pages — present for PDF documents (render_pdf, fill_form) only.

resourceUri.description: Stable read URI `docgen://document/{documentId}` resolving to the document.

sheetCount.description: Number of worksheets — present for xlsx documents (export_spreadsheet) only.

ttlSecondsRemaining.description: Seconds until the stored artifact expires and becomes unreadable.

engine.description: The PDF rendering engine that produced the document.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_source`: None of html / markdown / template+data was provided, more than one source form was, a template was given without data, or data was given without a template. `template_render_failed`: The template referenced a data key absent from the data object, or was malformed. `document_too_large`: The rendered PDF exceeded the configured maximum document size. `render_timeout`: Rendering exceeded the configured time budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

title: docgen-mcp-server
